english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a prediction or estimate made without firm evidence.
This is the all-purpose noun for a rough, non-final calculation or assessment.
This is the all-purpose noun for an estimate, whether referring to the act of estimating or the resulting amount.
Use this when calculation means an estimate or reckoning, as in 按我嘅估計 ‘by my estimate’.

examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 zi2 hai6 ngo5 ge3 gu2 gai3

examples.english: This estimate should be about right.
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 gu2 gai3 jing1 goi1 caa1 m4 do1

examples.english: This is only a rough estimation and may not be accurate.
examples.traditional: 呢個只係粗略估計，未必準確。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 zi2 hai6 cou1 loek6 gu2 gai3 mei6 bit1 zeon2 kok3

examples.english: By my calculation, it will rain tomorrow.
examples.traditional: 按我嘅估計，聽日會落雨。
examples.jyutping: on3 ngo5 ge3 gu2 gai3 ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5
